I treat it like I would ciggs, as in I only do it on breaks / lunch / etc, never inside (I need to stretch my legs anyway), and never around my family. If anything it's far less expensive. When I picked it up initially I would do it just about everywhere and all the time, it just doesn't work like that for me, my being prone to addiction let it become a problem.

Depending on where I order from, it's not really any more expensive, and I had found a lot of ways to make smoking cheaper. Fact of the matter is, though, that I enjoy this way more than I ever did smoking. I've started limiting myself to big purchases every six months, which is a serious slowdown over the last two years, but I'm able to pick up nicer things for it (Origen Genesis V2 and the XvoSTick are next on my list for acquisitions!). Since I've taken to purchasing authentics, it's easier to sell them after I get them if I don't like them for very little loss (my R91s went for $75 each after using them every. single. day. for eight months), so it's hardly even a rental fee.

All in, I feel like it's pretty well worth it for me at least. The nice thing about beginner/intermediate gear is that you go through juice way more slowly =P

Since the unfortunate shutdown of /r/Nintendo3DSROMS, I have taken it upon myself to resurrect a form of the sub here. So with that, there will be some ground rules.

1) AS OF NOW THE ONLY APPROVED HOST IS MEGA. I will take others into consideration, however I do not have plans to include any others at this time.

2) PLEASE, ONLY RAW .3DS FILES YOU HAVE DUMPED YOURSELF. No scene files, no .cia converted hacks, no trimmed ROMs. In the event of an eShop-only game the raw .cia file will be accepted. I wish to maintain clean dumps here, free from any form of editing outside of the private header.

THE ONLY TIME SCENE RELEASES ARE ALLOWED ARE IN THE CASE OF A LEAK (i.e. MAJORA'S MASK). THE POST CONTAINING THE LEAK WILL BE ALLOWED UNTIL THE GAME IS OFFICIALLY RELEASED, AT WHICH POINT A PROPER PRIVATE DUMP WILL REPLACE IT.

3) PLEASE USE THE [3DS], [eSHOP], [LEAK], [DLC], [THEME], [REGION], TAGS. It makes everything a lot easier to filter and sort.

4) STAY ON TOPIC. Self-Explanatory.

ANY POSTS FOUND VIOLATING THESE RULES WILL BE REMOVED AND THE POSTERS NOTIFIED.

With all that out of the way, we're glad to see you here. :)
